testsuite.name: com.neurovault.backend.encryption.RsaKeyServiceTest

testcase.name: wrapKey/unwrapKey round-trip should recover original AES key
unwrapping with wrong private key should fail
encodePublicKey/encodePrivateKey should produce non-empty Base64 strings
generateKeyPair() should produce a valid RSA-4096 key pair
wrapping same key twice should produce different wrapped values
